series.name: Axpert VM III / VMiii PRIME (1.5/3/5KW)
series.notes: Axpert VM III OEM manual — medium via Scribd listing 'VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425' (Tesla SKU association). Codes 01–09/51–53/55/57–59 + W-prefixed warnings (W01–W32).

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Fan blade jammed by dust, a wire or a seized bearing
causes.ur: Pankha ki blade dhag, taar ya jam ho gayi bearing ki wajah se atki hui hai

causes.en: Fan connector loose or fan motor burnt/open
causes.ur: Pankha ka connector dhila hai ya fan motor jal ya open ho gayi hai

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate AC and DC supply before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karein aur case kholne se pehle AC aur DC dono supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Turn the fan blade by hand — it must spin free; clear dust or any object jamming it.
solutions.ur: Pankha ki blade haath se ghuma kar dekhein — bilkul azaad ghoomni chahiye; dhag ya atki hui cheez nikalein.

solutions.en: Check the fan connector and supply; if the motor is jammed or burnt, replace the fan, then restore supply and confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: Pankha ka connector aur supply check karein; motor jam ya jal gayi ho to pankha badlein, phir supply wapas laga kar code khatam ho gaya yeh confirm karein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Cooling fan slow or heatsink choked with dust
causes.ur: Cooling fan slow chal raha hai ya heatsink dhag se band hai

causes.en: Heavy load or hot ambient for a long time raised temperature
causes.ur: Lambi der tak zyada load ya garam mausam ki wajah se garmi barh gayi

solutions.en: Turn the unit off and let it cool down, keeping AC supply isolated while you check.
solutions.ur: Unit band kar dein aur thanda hone dein, jab tak check karein AC supply alag hi rakhein.

solutions.en: Clean dust from the heatsink, confirm the cooling fan runs and the air vents are not blocked.
solutions.ur: Heatsink se dhag saaf karein, cooling fan chal raha hai aur vents band nahi hain yeh confirm karein.

solutions.en: If the fan or sensor fails on test, replace it; avoid heavy load until temperature is normal, then restart and retest.
solutions.ur: Test mein fan ya sensor kharab mile to badlein; temperature normal hone tak zyada load na dein, phir restart karke dobara check karein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Charger float/absorption voltage set too high for this battery
causes.ur: Charger ka float/absorption voltage is battery ke liye bohat zyada set hai

causes.en: Battery sulphated or charger not cutting off at full charge
causes.ur: Battery sulphated ho gayi ya charger full charge par cut-off nahi kar raha

solutions.en: Stop charging now — switch off the inverter and isolate AC supply, and keep batteries away from sparks.
solutions.ur: Abhi charging band karein — inverter off karein aur AC supply alag kar lein, battery ke paas spark na dein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a meter and compare it with the charger float/absorption setting in the menu.
solutions.ur: Battery ka voltage meter se naapein aur menu mein charger ki float/absorption setting se compare karein.

solutions.en: If charger output is too high or a battery cell is dead, have the charger or battery checked and replaced, then retest.
solutions.ur: Charger ka output bohat zyada hai ya koi cell dead hai to charger ya battery check ya replace karwayein, phir dobara check karein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged or old and weak
causes.ur: Battery bilkul discharge ho gayi hai ya purani aur kamzor hai

causes.en: Loose battery terminals or thin long cables causing voltage drop
causes.ur: Battery ke terminal dhile hain ya patli lambi taar ki wajah se voltage gir raha hai

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate DC before checking any battery wiring.
solutions.ur: Battery wiring check karne se pehle inverter band karein aur DC alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure battery resting voltage with a meter and tighten and clean the terminals and cable lugs.
solutions.ur: Battery ka resting voltage meter se naapein aur terminal/cable lugs ko kassi kar saaf karein.

solutions.en: Charge the batteries from a known supply; if an old battery will not hold charge, replace it and retest.
solutions.ur: Battery ko kisi ache source se charge karein; purani battery charge na rok sake to badal kar dobara check karein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Load wiring shorted or insulation melted at the output
causes.ur: Load ki taaron mein short hai ya output par insulation pighal gaya hai

causes.en: Converter overloaded or cooling blocked, so temperature crossed 120°C
causes.ur: Converter par zyada load tha ya cooling band thi, is liye garmi 120°C paar ho gayi

solutions.en: Stop immediately — turn off the inverter and isolate AC and DC supply, and do not keep restarting it.
solutions.ur: Foran ruk jayein — inverter off karein aur AC aur DC dono supply alag kar lein, baar baar restart na karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the load and check output wiring for a short, burnt smell or melted insulation using a meter.
solutions.ur: Load utaar kar output wiring mein short, jalan ki boo ya gulab ho chuka insulation meter se check karein.

solutions.en: Clear the short or replace the damaged cable or load; if the converter is very hot, let it cool and have the unit checked before restoring power.
solutions.ur: Short theek karein ya kharab taar/load badlein; converter bohat garm ho to thanda hone dein aur power wapas lagane se pehle unit check karwayein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Output voltage regulation fault on the control PCB
causes.ur: Control PCB par output voltage regulate nahi ho raha

causes.en: Load very light or feedback wiring open giving a wrong sense reading
causes.ur: Load bohat halka hai ya feedback ki taar khuli hui hai, reading ghalat aa rahi hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC supply before measuring the output voltage.
solutions.ur: Output voltage naapne se pehle power band karein aur AC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure output voltage with a meter and check the sense and feedback wiring for looseness.
solutions.ur: Output voltage meter se naapein aur sense aur feedback ki taar dhili hai yeh check karein.

solutions.en: Tighten loose connections; if voltage still reads high, have the regulation circuit on the PCB checked before reconnecting the load.
solutions.ur: Dhile connection theek karein; voltage phir bhi zyada aaye to load dobara lagane se pehle PCB par regulation circuit check karwayein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

title.ur: Load zyada rehne par time out

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Connected load more than the inverter rating
causes.ur: Laga hua load inverter ki rating se zyada hai

causes.en: Motor or compressor drawing high starting current
causes.ur: Motor ya compressor start par bohat zyada current le raha hai

solutions.en: Turn off the inverter and isolate AC supply, then disconnect heavy loads.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karein, AC supply alag kar dein aur bhaari load utaar dein.

solutions.en: Compare the total connected load with the inverter rating and remove extra appliances one by one.
solutions.ur: Kul load ko inverter ki rating se compare karein aur ek ek karke extra appliances utaarte jayein.

solutions.en: Start again only when the load is within rating; if a motor draws high starting current, reduce the load or have the unit checked.
solutions.ur: Load rating ke andar ho tabhi dobara on karein; motor zyada starting current le raha hai to load kam karein ya unit check karwayein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

meaning.ur: DC bus par voltage zyada ho gaya.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: High PV input or grid feed pushing the bus voltage up
causes.ur: PV input ya grid se zyada aane par bus voltage barh gaya

causes.en: Load suddenly removed while the bus was charging
causes.ur: Bus charge hote waqt load achanak hat gaya

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before probing the DC bus.
solutions.ur: DC bus check karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC dono alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Let the bus discharge, then measure PV input and battery voltage and check the settings for high PV input.
solutions.ur: Bus ko discharge hone dein, phir PV input aur battery voltage naapein aur setting mein zyada PV input check karein.

solutions.en: Bring PV input within the limit or fix the load-dump situation, then power up and confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: PV input limit ke andar karein ya load achanak hatne ki situation theek karein, phir power on karke code khatam hua yeh dekhein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: DC bus not reaching start voltage — weak battery or high load
causes.ur: DC bus ka start voltage nahi ban raha — battery kamzor hai ya load zyada hai

causes.en: Pre-charge circuit or main relay faulty
causes.ur: Pre-charge circuit ya main relay kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before any further testing.
solutions.ur: Aage koi bhi test karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC dono alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure battery and DC bus voltage at power-on and check the pre-charge circuit and main relay.
solutions.ur: On karte waqt battery aur DC bus voltage naapein aur pre-charge circuit aur main relay check karein.

solutions.en: Charge or replace a weak battery and repair the pre-charge circuit or relay if faulty, then power up and confirm soft start completes.
solutions.ur: Kamzor battery charge ya replace karein aur kharab pre-charge circuit ya relay theek karein, phir power on karke soft start mukammal hua yeh confirm karein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

meaning.ur: Current zyada ya surge aane se trip ho gaya.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Load inrush or surge higher than the set limit
causes.ur: Load ka inrush ya surge set limit se zyada tha

causes.en: Current sensor reading high or a short developing on output
causes.ur: Current sensor zyada reading de raha hai ya output mein short ban raha hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before any further testing.
solutions.ur: Aage koi bhi test karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC dono alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the load, check the output wiring for a short and measure current with a meter when restarting.
solutions.ur: Load utaar kar output wiring mein short check karein aur restart par current meter se naapein.

solutions.en: Remove the overloaded or shorted load or repair the wiring; if the trip repeats with no load, have the power section checked.
solutions.ur: Zyada load ya short wala load utaarein ya wiring theek karein; load ke bawajood trip dobara ho to power section check karwayein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

meaning.ur: DC bus par voltage kam ho gaya.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Battery weak/deeply discharged or battery cables loose
causes.ur: Battery kamzor ya discharge hai ya battery taarein dhili hain

causes.en: Input supply missing or pre-charge circuit faulty
causes.ur: Input supply nahi aa rahi ya pre-charge circuit kharab hai

solutions.en: Switch off the unit and isolate supply before checking battery and DC wiring.
solutions.ur: Battery aur DC wiring check karne se pehle unit band karein aur supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage at the inverter terminals and check cable tightness and the fuse.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke terminals par battery voltage naapein aur taaron ki kassi aur fuse check karein.

solutions.en: Charge or replace a weak battery and repair loose or faulty wiring, then power up and retest.
solutions.ur: Kamzor battery charge ya replace karein aur dhili ya kharab wiring theek karein, phir power on karke dobara check karein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Output relay not picking up or its contacts pitted/welded
causes.ur: Output relay pick nahi kar raha ya uske contacts kharab ya chipak gaye hain

causes.en: Load too heavy at switch-on or inverter power section faulty
causes.ur: On karte hi load bohat zyada hai ya inverter ka power section kharab hai

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate AC and DC supply before checking the output relay.
solutions.ur: Output relay check karne se pehle inverter band karein aur AC aur DC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Listen for the relay click at power-on and check output relay contacts and wiring with a meter.
solutions.ur: On karte waqt relay ki awaaz sunein aur output relay contacts aur wiring meter se check karein.

solutions.en: Replace a stuck relay or repair its drive; if the load was too heavy at start, reduce the load and retest.
solutions.ur: Atka hua relay badlein ya uska drive theek karein; start par load zyada tha to load kam karke dobara check karein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

title.en: Over DC voltage in AC output

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Output filter capacitor leaked or degraded
causes.ur: Output filter capacitor leak kar gaya hai ya kamzor ho gaya hai

causes.en: Switching device or feedback path faulty and injecting DC
causes.ur: Switching device ya feedback path kharab hai jo AC mein DC daal raha hai

solutions.en: Turn off the inverter and isolate AC and DC supply before measuring the output.
solutions.ur: Output naapne se pehle inverter band karein aur AC aur DC dono alag kar lein.

solutions.en: With the load disconnected, meter-check DC on the AC output and inspect the output filter capacitors.
solutions.ur: Load khud karke AC output par DC meter se check karein aur output filter capacitors dekhein.

solutions.en: Replace leaked output capacitors or faulty switching parts, then only restore supply and re-measure.
solutions.ur: Leak hue output capacitor ya kharab switching parts badlein, uske baad hi supply wapas laga kar dobara naapein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Sensor connector loose or sensing wires broken
causes.ur: Sensor ka connector dhila hai ya sensing taarein toot gayi hain

causes.en: CT / current sensor module burnt
causes.ur: CT ya current sensor module jal gaya hai

solutions.en: Switch off the unit and isolate supply before checking the sensor.
solutions.ur: Sensor check karne se pehle unit band karein aur supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Check the sensor connector and meter-check the wiring continuity.
solutions.ur: Sensor connector check karein aur wiring ka continuity meter se naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the CT or current sensor if the reading stays invalid, then restore supply and confirm a normal reading.
solutions.ur: Reading theek na aaye to CT ya current sensor badlein, phir supply wapas laga kar reading normal hai yeh confirm karein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Heavy load dragging the output voltage down
causes.ur: Zyada load ki wajah se output voltage neeche gir gaya

causes.en: Loose output connections or weak battery/DC supply
causes.ur: Output ke connections dhile hain ya battery/DC supply kamzor hai

solutions.en: Turn off the inverter and isolate supply before checking the load side.
solutions.ur: Load side check karne se pehle inverter band karein aur supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure output voltage under load and check battery/DC voltage and the output connections.
solutions.ur: Load par output voltage naapein aur battery/DC voltage aur output connections check karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load or tighten loose connections; if voltage stays low with a good battery, have the inverter power section checked.
solutions.ur: Load kam karein ya dhile connection kassi karein; achi battery ke baad bhi voltage kam rahe to inverter ka power section check karwayein.

source.title: Axpert VM III 1.5/3/5KW manual (local axpert_vmiii.pdf; Tesla SKU via Scribd 896972628 VMiii PRIME Tesla-61425)

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: String open-circuit voltage above the inverter limit
causes.ur: String ka open-circuit voltage inverter ki limit se zyada hai

causes.en: Too many panels in series for this model
causes.ur: Is model ke liye series mein bohat zyada panels lage hue hain

solutions.en: Isolate the PV supply and cover the panels before checking string wiring.
solutions.ur: String wiring check karne se pehle PV supply alag karein aur panels par cover lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure string open-circuit voltage with a meter and compare it with the inverter limit given in the manual.
solutions.ur: String ka open-circuit voltage meter se naapein aur manual mein di gayi inverter limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce panels in series to within the limit; if voltage still reads high, check the PV input sensing before powering up.
solutions.ur: Series mein panels limit ke andar karein; voltage phir bhi zyada aaye to power on karne se pehle PV input sensing check karein.
